editorial.blurb: Lou Malnati's is the real deal for Chicago deep-dish pizza—thick buttery crust, rich tomato sauce, and generous toppings made by people who actually care.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead 15 minutes before arriving to minimize wait times, and try the sausage deep dish with butter crust; ask for the new meatballs with giardinera and burrata appetizer.
